text:
mira-peopleops: Heads-up: two interviewers flagged that the guidance in their prep email didn't match the guidance on the scorecard during today's onsites. Candidates saw different "focus" bullets in the invite vs scorecard.

owen-recruiter: saw similar for hiring team backend-panel B. The UI shows the latest draft (v3) but emails referenced v2 language. Several interviewers DMd me asking which is canonical.

leo-eng: thanks, investigating. We ship a publish step for templates but the scheduler caches the last-published copy. Looks like publish succeeded but cache invalidation failed.

ui-bot: note: template.publish event 2017651000 for templ-backend-b was processed, publish_version: "v3-d8f2".

leo-eng: repro notes: (1) template edit -> publish -> user sees v3 in UI, (2) scheduler job reads cache key guidance:templ-backend-b -> cache miss, falls back to last-known blob (v2) because our cache invalidation uses background TTL.

mira-peopleops: how did this get by QA? We need invites to always include guidance_version so interviewers can tell which text was used.

leo-eng: agree. Short-term patch: (A) include guidance_version and guidance_hash in invite payload so the email footer shows "guidance v3 (hash: d8f2)"; (B) add a force-reload endpoint on scheduler /scheduler/refresh-template/:id to immediately pull the DB canonical copy; (C) run refresh for all jobs scheduled in next 24h. I can ship (A)+(B) in next 2-3 hours.

owen-recruiter: appreciate that. Will we auto-re-send invites after refresh? Some candidates got the wrong copy.

leo-eng: plan: resend only when guidance_version differs between scheduler cache and canonical DB. We'll add a preview diff and mark invites that need resend. For privacy we'll only resend to interviewer participants, not to candidates, unless Talent Ops asks.

ui-bot: deploy-bot: rolling deploy triggered for scheduler service (patch: guidance_version in invites) -> 2017652800.

mira-peopleops: long-term ask: can we make the publish step create an immutable guidance artifact with an ETag and require scheduler to reference artifact://templ-backend-b/v3 rather than storing copy in cache? That guarantees exactness and simplifies auditing.

leo-eng: agree; adding artifact-backed publish is on our backlog. Proposed implementation: publish creates artifact with metadata {version, author, published_at, hash}, scheduler references artifact id and uses HTTP If-None-Match to validate. Also add UI badge: "published: v3 @ 2026-05-12 14:02 UTC".

owen-recruiter: also request a small UI note for interviewers: "If you receive conflicting guidance between email and scorecard, open the scorecard -> click 'View published guidance'". That should reduce confusion while we finish infra work.

mira-peopleops: agree. For immediate comms I'll post in #interviewer-announcements: quick note + ask interviewers to check guidance_version in footer.

scheduler-bot: automated alert: queued 14 templates for immediate refresh (triggered by mira-peopleops).

leo-eng: will post PR with force-refresh endpoint + invite payload change in ~2h. Also adding telemetry event templates.invite_mismatch with template_id, scheduled_job_id, diff_size.

mira-peopleops: thanks. Once PR is up, I'll coordinate a targeted resend for impacted panels and draft the interviewer blurb.

owen-recruiter: thanks all 44d
